name: How to Dismantle an Atomic Bomb

podcast.body: This album was about to be released in 2004. At this time, Paul McGuinness discussed the importance of business acumen for artists like U2. "U2 was about to release their How to Dismantle and Atomic Bomb album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album was described as "less acclaimed" compared to Kanye West's "Late Registration." U2 won Album of the Year in 2006 with this album, a decision that was criticized as a repeat win over a more celebrated contemporary album. "U2's less acclaimed How to Dismantle an Atomic Bomb".
